name: 角斗士主观镜头·斗兽场混战
desc: 15秒单镜角斗士主观视角：敌方战士穿过尘埃与阳光冲来被摔进沙地，随后整座竞技场在镜头四周陷入全面混战，保持自然头部晃动不剪不变焦。
original: One continuous shot, POV gladiator perspective in the Colosseum arena, no cuts, no zoom, natural head movement, a furious enemy warrior sprints straight toward the camera through thick dust and sunlight, heavy footsteps shaking the ground, as he reaches close the POV character reacts instantly — grabs him mid-charge and slams him violently onto the sand, powerful impact, dust explosion, no pause, immediate chaos erupts all around, multiple gladiators fighting simultaneously, intense close combat everywhere, swords clashing, shields smashing, bodies colliding, archers releasing arrows overhead, a chariot bursts through the scene, fighters falling and getting back up, constant aggressive motion, POV character fights barehanded with raw force — blocking strikes, grabbing opponents, throwing them aside, fast reactions, heavy hits, kinetic movement, camera shaking from impacts, breath sounds, dust in the air, dramatic sunlight beams cutting through shadows, epic scale, high intensity battlefield, cinematic, photorealistic, ultra detailed, motion blur on hits Total: 15s / 1 shot / 16:9
src: 用户直供·Seedance2.0提示词合集｜POV：角斗士
zh: 单次连续镜头，罗马斗兽场内的角斗士第一人称 POV 视角；不剪切、不变焦，保持自然的头部运动。一名狂怒的敌方战士穿过浓厚尘埃和阳光，径直冲向摄影机，沉重脚步令地面震动。当他逼近时，第一人称角色立刻作出反应，在冲锋途中将其抓住，并猛烈摔向沙地。强大的撞击掸起爆炸般的尘土。没有停顿，四周立即陷入混乱：多名角斗士同时战斗，到处都是激烈近身搏杀；刀剑碰撞、盾牌猛击、身体相撞，弓箭手从头顶射出箭雨，一辆战车突然冲过战场；战士们不断倒下又重新起身，所有运动持续激烈而富有攻击性。第一人称角色仅凭双手和原始力量战斗：格挡攻击、抓住对手、将其甩开；反应迅速、打击沉重、动作充满动势。摄影机随撞击震动，能够听见呼吸声；空气中充满尘土，戏剧性的阳光光束穿透阴影。史诗级规模、高强度战场、电影感、照片级写实、超高细节，击打瞬间带运动模糊。 总计：15 秒 / 1 个镜头 / 16:9

name: 火车顶双女武士·坠河慢镜
desc: 15秒单镜：摄影机从车顶边缘下方升起环绕高速列车顶交锋的两名女武士，刀锋削断发丝时进入慢动作，随两人一同坠入河中并延伸到水下。
original: Single continuous shot 15s: The camera begins below the train roof level — an extreme low angle looking up from beneath the rushing steel edge, the grey sky above and the train's metal roof surface filling the upper frame, power line cables visible on both sides, electric sparks already arcing between the cables and the roof surface in irregular white-blue bursts. The FPV arm accelerates upward and crests the rooftop edge just as both female samurai asian girls warriors sprint into frame from opposite ends of the carriage roof — dark armor catching the electric flash light, katanas already drawn and trailing behind them — the camera dropping to roof level and sweeping immediately into a full 360-degree orbit around both fighters as they clash center-roof, blades ringing against each other, feet sliding on the curved metal surface, the passing landscape blurring at speed on both sides and the electric sparks erupting in curtains around them with each power cable they pass beneath. The orbit completes and the camera settles tight behind the first warrior as she draws back her katana in a full overhead swing — the motion ramping into deep slow motion, every detail suspended: the blade arc, the electric spark frozen mid-burst beside her shoulder, the second warrior already reading the strike and arching her entire body backward in a deep spine bend, the katana blade sweeping through the space where her face was a fraction of a second before, the flat of the blade passing directly in front of her eyes at centimeter distance — and a single small lock of dark hair catching the blade edge and separating, the severed strand drifting upward in the slow motion wind. The motion snaps back to full speed as the second warrior completes her dodge and drives her elbow into the first warrior's chest simultaneously, the two fighters exchanging rapid blade-locked strikes across the carriage roof as the electric sparks shower around them. The camera pulls back to a wide rooftop angle as both warriors simultaneously lock arms, pivot, and drive each other outward over the edge — both bodies leaving the roof in the same moment, tumbling sideways off the carriage and falling through open air toward the river running parallel to the track below, the camera descending with them in a controlled drop, both fighters still gripping their katanas with arms extended toward each other during the two-second fall. Both bodies hit the river surface simultaneously in twin white explosions, and the camera plunges beneath the surface with them — the world going deep blue-green, sunlight filtering down in shafts from above, both warriors already moving through the underwater space toward each other, dark armor trailing bubbles, katanas extended, the fight continuing in the silent slow drift of the river current. NO MUSIC / NO SFX Total: 15s / 1 shot / 16:9
src: 用户直供·Seedance2.0提示词合集｜打斗：火车
zh: 15 秒单次连续镜头：摄影机从低于火车车顶的位置开始，以极低机位从高速掠过的钢制边缘下方向上仰拍。上方灰色天空与火车金属车顶占据画面上半部，两侧可见电力线缆，线缆与车顶表面之间已经出现不规则的白蓝色电弧爆闪。FPV 飞行摄影机加速上升并越过车顶边缘。就在此时，两名亚洲女性武士分别从车厢顶部两端冲入画面；深色盔甲反射着电光，武士刀早已出鞘并拖在身后。摄影机下降到车顶高度，在两人于车顶中央交锋的瞬间立刻展开完整的 360 度环绕。刀锋铿锵碰撞，双脚在弧形金属表面滑动，两侧飞驰而过的景物因速度而模糊。每当火车从电力线下方驶过，电火花便如帘幕般在她们周围爆发。 环绕完成后，摄影机紧贴第一名武士身后稳定下来。她向后引刀，准备完成一次从头顶劈下的完整斩击，动作逐渐进入深度慢镜头，所有细节仿佛悬停：刀刃划出的弧线、她肩旁冻结在爆发途中的电火花。第二名武士已经预判攻击，将整个身体向后弯成极深的脊柱弧线。武士刀扫过她在不到一秒前面部所在的位置，刀身平面以仅数厘米的距离从她眼前掠过；一小缕深色头发碰到刀锋并被切断，断发在慢动作的风中向上飘起。 动作瞬间恢复正常速度。第二名武士在完成闪避的同时，用手胘猛击第一名武士的胸口。两人在车厢顶部展开快速的刀刃锁架与连续对攻，电火花如雨般洒落在四周。摄影机后拉为车顶广角镜头。两名武士同时锁住对方手臂、旋转身体，并将彼此推向车顶外侧；两人的身体在同一瞬间离开车顶，侧向翻滚跌出车厢，穿过空中坠向下方与铁路平行流淌的河流。摄影机以受控的下降动作跟随她们。在持续两秒的坠落中，两人仍紧握武士刀，手臂朝向彼此伸展。她们同时撞击河面，形成两团白色爆炸般的水花，摄影机随两人一起扎入水下。整个世界转为深蓝绿色，阳光从上方以光柱形式穿透水体。两名武士已经在水下空间中朝彼此移动，深色盔甲拖曳着气泡，武士刀向前伸出，战斗在河流寂静、缓慢的漂移中继续。 无音乐 / 无音效 总计：15 秒 / 1 个镜头 / 16:9
